Solutions · 01

Critical care nutrition.

In the ICU, feeding strategy is part of the treatment plan. We formulate for altered metabolism — hypercatabolism, organ dysfunction, fluid restriction — so nutrition supports the outcome instead of complicating it.

Setting
ICU · HDU · Recovery wards
Approach
Disease-specific
Delivery
Oral & enteral
Users
Clinical teams
01The protocol

Five steps, closed loop.

Our products and devices map onto the standard clinical nutrition workflow — so adopting them changes nothing about how your team works, only how well it is supplied.

  1. 01

    Screen

    Nutritional risk identified on admission.

  2. 02

    Assess

    Metabolic state, organ function, and requirements quantified.

  3. 03

    Formulate

    Disease-specific formulation matched to the assessment.

  4. 04

    Deliver

    Oral or enteral delivery with device-supported precision.

  5. 05

    Monitor

    Outcomes tracked; formulation adjusted as the patient recovers.
